groups.saying_opens: إذا سمعتم به بأرض فلا تقدموا عليه

levels.surface: عبد الله بن، عامر بن ربيعة

notes: Two sayings with their own isnads: the Prophet's words (Abd al-Rahman b. Awf speaks inside Ibn Shihab's story, so he is the last link, owner ruling 5) and Umar's turning back, reported from Salim; both are stored and labelled
Saying 2 opens «وعن ابن شهاب» mid-report, and its head before Ibn Shihab is not written here: only the names the text gives are kept; a fuller head would be a guess
«فرجع عمر بن الخطاب من سرغ» is the story's narrative, not a link
